Impolite staff
Dec 2024 • Solo
I wanted to share my recent experience at Le Zink restaurant. As a loyal customer, I was looking forward to enjoying a good meal. Unfortunately, that night I couldn't find a table available, being alone. So I had to sit at a high table, but I didn't feel comfortable.

When customers left their tables, I thought I could switch places. However, a staff member informed me that I should stay in my seat, which disappointed me. I then decided to cancel my order and leave the restaurant.

I am a little sad about this experience, as I usually appreciate the atmosphere and the quality of the dishes.
